 What is Hue doing to help its tourism industry "live with"... rain?
 Prolonged rain and unpredictable weather have caused considerable difficulties for tourism in Hue, especially during the last months of the year. The city is considering restructuring its tourism products and developing experiences related to heritage, cuisine, art, and relaxation to maintain its appeal as a year-round destination.
 Người Đưa Tin • 31/10/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Diverse experiences during the rainy season
 Today (October 31st), the People's Committee of Hue City held a conference to announce stimulus measures and a press conference on new tourism products in the city until 2027. The conference was attended by hundreds of travel agencies, accommodation establishments, as well as KOLs and influencers on social media.
 At the conference, the city announced its plan to restructure tourism products and develop new products for the period 2027-2030. 
 Prolonged rain and unpredictable weather have caused considerable difficulties for tourism in Hue , especially during the last months of the year.
 One of the topics that attracted much attention at the conference was the discussion about Hue's rainy season tourism products, aiming to extend the operating period and reduce the seasonality of the local tourism industry.
 The rainy season in Hue usually begins in September and lasts until December each year, with October and November often experiencing heavy rains , storms, and floods. In reality, prolonged rain, high humidity, and cool weather not only affect sightseeing schedules but also create difficulties for beach tourism, ecotourism, and outdoor activities.
 According to the plan announced at the conference, to adapt, the city aims to develop rain tourism products based on its strengths in heritage, culture, cuisine , art, traditional crafts, shopping, and healthcare. These itineraries need to be designed to be regularly organized, less dependent on weather, and include specific schedules, durations, prices, and booking methods.
 You may also like Among the products planned for launch from 2027, a notable one is the "Hue Rainy Season Art and Music Night" program, featuring performances of Hue folk songs, court music, traditional arts, and heritage storytelling in indoor spaces such as Duyet Thi Duong, An Dinh Palace, Kien Trung Palace, or other suitable locations.
 In addition, there is the product "Rainy Day Getaway in Hue," connecting hotels, resorts, and spas with services such as herbal foot baths, massage, meditation, yoga, and nutrition. The product "Hue Rainy Season Photography" focuses on showcasing the beauty of architecture, gardens, heritage spaces, and streetscapes, combined with enjoying tea, coffee, and cuisine at various stops...
 We need products that are appropriate to the context and meet real-world needs.
 Despite its advantages in heritage, culture, and cuisine, the challenge for Hue tourism during the rainy season is not only to add more experiential activities, but also to develop products that are attractive enough to be regularly exploited and generate substantial revenue.
 According to the city's plan, the "Hue in the Rainy Season – Heritage, Cuisine, and Shopping" tourism package will be developed based on connecting visits to the Imperial Citadel and other heritage sites with culinary experiences, traditional crafts, indoor art performances, and shopping at AEON MALL Hue. The itinerary may be expanded with the Hue- Da Nang train route when operational conditions and service connections meet the requirements. 
 According to Mr. Tran Huu Thuy Giang, Vice Chairman of the People's Committee of Hue City, it is necessary to diversify tourism products related to the rainy season to suit the context and actual needs.
 In addition, the city will take advantage of favorable weather periods to develop marine and lagoon tourism products, ecotourism, and resort tourism; while strengthening linkages between travel agencies, accommodation providers, transportation companies, and tourist attractions to create diverse product packages to serve tourists year-round.
 You may also like Programs should be designed flexibly, offering half-day, full-day, or multi-day tours, linked to schedules, pricing, booking methods, and alternative plans in case of adverse weather conditions. Safety must be the top priority, and activities should not be organized in areas at risk from heavy rain, flooding, or other natural disasters.
 Speaking at the conference, Mr. Tran Huu Thuy Giang, Vice Chairman of the People's Committee of Hue City, said that the development of tourism during the rainy season needs to be viewed from the perspective of diversifying experiences, instead of just exploiting simple activities like drinking coffee and watching the rain.
 According to him, Hue has many advantages in terms of landscape, heritage, culture, and cuisine to develop products suitable for the characteristics of the autumn-winter weather. Therefore, businesses need to develop more diverse experiences, combining relaxation, meditation, yoga, tea tasting, and activities appropriate to the context.
 "The Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism and related units are requested to research and restructure the system of rainy season tourism products in a practical way, closely aligned with market needs and actual exploitation conditions," the Vice Chairman of the People's Committee of Hue City emphasized.
 Le Cong
